items.title: 68113_Barney Bigard oral history interview
items.q: I knew Vic and Octave. They were the most important ones to know because they got the work.

ctx.x: Well, he was well known in New Orleans. He used to get a lot of jobs, and if he'd hire you quite a bit, you had to have a little book to put the dates down so you wouldn't forget them, because in those days they didn't use much telephoning these houses. So that's the way we got along.
